name: H3 Extend SGLang
summary: Continues an existing clip through SGLang Ref2VA, using the tail as motion context and joining the new part after it.

inputs.label: Clip to extend
inputs.help: At least 2 seconds. The continuation is appended after this clip.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: Continue the motion, camera and scene from <Video 1>, keeping the same people, place, light and sound. The scene continues naturally.
inputs.help: Describe what happens next. The source tail is Video 1; extra reference videos are Video 2+; images are Picture 1-9; audio clips are Audio 1-3.

inputs.label: Reference images
inputs.help: Identity, outfit, product or style references. These do not replace the source tail; they supplement it.

inputs.label: Extra reference videos
inputs.help: Optional motion/camera references. The source tail is Video 1; these are Video 2 and Video 3. The tail (2-2.6 s) counts toward the 15 s total video budget, so keep these extras short.

inputs.label: Reference audio
inputs.help: Voice, music or sound-style references. Audio has its own 15 s budget, separate from video.

inputs.label: New part (s)
inputs.help: Length of the generated part before the motion context is trimmed. The total request (new part + context) must stay within 10 seconds: 8 s with 48-frame context, 7 s with 63-frame context.

inputs.label: Motion context
inputs.help: Frames cut from the end of the source and added as Video 1. 63 frames keeps the tail above SGLang's 2 s reference-video minimum.

inputs.label: Steps
inputs.help: Fewer steps run faster and look rougher.

notes: Draft: the adapter cuts the configured tail, adds it as Ref2VA Video 1, keeps up to 9 images and 2 extra videos, generates a continuation, trims the context head, and concatenates source + new part with audio. GPU validation is pending. SGLang V2V is reference conditioning, not an exact latent guide.
